summary: The proposed patch changes the condition to check for an empty __all__ attribute, which may not fully address the issue and could introduce behavioral regression.

issues.description: The patch only checks if self.__all__ is None, but the issue is about an empty list. This does not resolve the case where __all__ is an empty list.
Changing the condition to check for None instead of an empty list could lead to behavioral regression, as it might affect how modules with no __all__ attribute are handled.
